transcript.content: Hello, thank you for coming in. What brings you here today?

I came in because my head just feels cloudy lately. I’ll be looking at a board packet or even a vendor email, and I can’t seem to make simple decisions that I used to handle pretty quickly. It’s been frustrating.
Have you been feeling down, losing interest in things you usually enjoy, or feeling more tired than usual lately?

Yeah… I guess I have been losing interest in things. I haven’t wanted to go to my dance class, or go look at the little galleries like I usually do. Even cooking Sunday food for my family feels like too much, and that’s something that normally makes me feel like myself.
Have you noticed any problems with your memory or thinking clearly lately, like forgetting things more often or having trouble following conversations?

Yes. Mostly it’s like my thinking is slow or cloudy. I’ll read a board packet or a vendor email and just sit there, not able to make even a simple decision that I usually would’ve handled pretty quick. It’s frustrating because I know I should be able to follow it, but my head just doesn’t feel clear.
Have you been feeling down or in a low mood most of the day, nearly every day, lately?
I’m not really sure. I mean, I haven’t felt like myself, but I don’t know if I’d say I’m down most of the day nearly every day. It’s more like I’m just kind of off.
Can you describe your mood throughout the day? Do you feel down or low most of the time, or is it more of an on-and-off feeling?

I don’t know that it’s most of the time. It kind of comes and goes. Some parts of the day I’m just quiet or not feeling right, and then other times I’m okay enough to get through what I need to do. It’s more on-and-off, I think.
Have you had periods where you felt unusually high, overly energetic, or irritable, where you might have made impulsive decisions or felt like you didn’t need much sleep?

Yes, I have had days like that. I wouldn’t say I felt “high” exactly, but I felt almost too bright and bold, like I was talking over people in association meetings. Then I’d come home and snap at my husband over some small thing. It felt like I was wound up and not quite myself.
How long do those periods of feeling overly energetic or irritable usually last? Do they go away after a few hours, or do they last for a whole day or more?

It’s not just a few hours, no. This sharper change in my energy and confidence, and then that low, cloudy feeling after, has been going on about two weeks now. It really started around when my husband retired and was suddenly home all day.

Can you tell me if you’ve had any distinct periods where your mood was noticeably elevated, irritable, or 'too bright and bold' for at least several days in a row — like a full day or more — where it was a clear change from your usual self?

Yes, I think so. There were days where I felt almost too bold, like I had more nerve than usual. At the association meetings I’d be talking over people, which isn’t really like me. And then later at home I’d get irritable and snap at my husband over something small. It felt like a clear change from how I usually am.
Can you tell me if those periods where you felt overly bold or irritable lasted for at least 4 days in a row?
Yes, it was more than four days. This sharper change in my energy and confidence has been going on about two weeks now, since my husband retired and started being home all day.
Can you tell me if the days when you felt overly bold or irritable happened at the same time as the low, cloudy feelings, or were there clear periods when one was happening without the other?

It was kind of mixed, I guess, but there were clear times where the bold or irritable part was what stood out. Like at the association meetings, I’d feel too bright and confident and talk over people. Then later at home I’d snap at my husband over some small thing. It wasn’t just the low, cloudy feeling the whole time.

Can you tell me if the times when you felt overly bold or irritable happened when you weren’t feeling the low, cloudy mood — like they were separate episodes rather than just part of the same overall low mood?

Yes, I think they were separate at times. Like, there were days I wasn’t really in that low, cloudy place, but I felt almost too bright and bold. I’d talk over people at the association meetings, and then later I’d come home and snap at my husband over some small thing. It felt different from just being down.
Can you tell me if the times when you felt overly bold or irritable lasted for at least a full week without letting up — like a distinct change in your mood that stayed for several days in a row?

Yes… it’s been going on about two weeks now. The sharper change in my energy and confidence, and then that low, cloudy feeling too, started around when my husband retired and was suddenly home all day.

Can you tell me if the times when you felt overly bold or irritable happened when you weren’t feeling the low, cloudy mood — like they were separate episodes rather than just part of the same overall low mood?

Yes, there were times like that. I wasn’t always feeling low when it happened. Some days I felt almost too bright or bold, like at the association meetings I’d talk over people more than I normally would. Then at home I’d get irritable and snap at my husband over something small. It felt separate from just feeling cloudy or down.
Can you tell me if the times when you felt overly bold or irritable lasted for at least a full week without letting up — like a distinct change in your mood that stayed for several days in a row?

Yes, it did last several days in a row. I’d say this sharper change in my energy and confidence, along with that low cloudy feeling, has been going on about two weeks now. It seemed to start around when my husband retired and was suddenly home all day.
Can you tell me if the times when you felt overly bright, bold, or irritable lasted for a full 7 days or more without letting up?

Yes, it’s been about two weeks, I’d say. That change in my energy and confidence didn’t really let up, and then the low, cloudy feeling was there too. It started around when my husband retired and was home all day.
Can you tell me if the times when you felt overly bright, bold, or irritable lasted for a full 7 days or more without letting up?

Yes, it lasted more than a week. It’s been about two weeks now, that sharper change in my energy and confidence, and then the low cloudy feeling along with it. It started around when my husband retired and was suddenly home all day.
